visualCharacteristics.purpose: contact/lead form built from authored field rows or a linked spreadsheet, with native validation and JSON POST submission

contentPattern.structure: either a link to a form spreadsheet (.json with Label, Name, Type, Required/Mandatory, Options, Placeholder columns) or one row per field: cell 1 = label (trailing * = required), cell 2 = type (text, email, tel, number, url, date, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, hidden, submit; inferred from label when omitted), cell 3 = placeholder or comma-separated options. Config rows: Action | submit URL, Success | message, Error | message

usage: Partner enquiry, privacy contact and opt-out forms.
reuseGuidance: Use for simple single-step forms. reCAPTCHA is not rendered; add a spam-protection integration separately.
